measures, 6 extended policies with their `rule`, `params`, `compute`, 4 `prerequisite` edges and 31

- **16 base policies, clause by clause** — every clause of `air_agg_multi_holding`,

- **The retired surface** — eleven declared retirements, eleven bearing documents that write them as
  retired, eleven "no longer in force" statements corpus-wide and not one more, so nothing has vanished
  and the KB retires nothing the source did not declare. The two clauses of `air_credit_validity` that
  matter to this task are each **split** correctly: `life_of_a_travel_credit_voucher_95c8e626` §4.1
  marks "a lapsed voucher was formerly permitted to be reissued onto a fresh voucher against the

  carries the same validity term as the voucher it replaces, counted from the day of reissue" — as a

- **Variants and measures** — all 63 parameters across all 7 brands have a prose home and every numeric
  value appears literally in the corpus (checked exhaustively). Spot-verified for the brand this task
  turns on: Economy Saver — agency service fee 29.95, credit reissue fee 75.00, credit validity 12
  months, "redeemable by another person: not permitted" (credits non-transferable), flat cancellation

### The two extended policies this task scores, in full

**`air_ext_credit_reissue_fee` — baseline.** `basis_of_the_credit_reissue_fee_cb574e79` carries the
whole `rule` at baseline: the fee is the brand's credit reissue fee "taken once for the voucher"; the
brand that produced the voucher is "the fare brand held on the air booking the voucher was issued on";
the `set_lapsed` test is rendered as "the travel credit vouchers standing on the booking are taken as
one set, and the set stands lapsed when the voucher most recently issued on it has lapsed", with the
negative case spelled out; the filing rule ("filed against the issue line of the largest lapsed voucher
standing on the booking, and it carries the traveller position of that line") and the rounding ("at the
end and never at any intermediate step") are both present. ✔

**`air_ext_credit_reissue_fee` — six declared factors, every tier:**

| factor | document | tiers carried |
|---|---|---|
| `lapse_clock_anchor` (method) | `dating_the_lapse_of_a_travel_credit_0b308e4a` | non-transferable + more than one → from the day the cancellation was confirmed; transferable + more than one → from the day the most recent voucher was issued; otherwise → from the day the most recent voucher lapsed. All three stated as methods, each with "the count closes on the handling date", and the first with "neither the issue day nor the lapse day of any voucher opens the count" ✔ |
| `lapse_age_loading` | `how_long_a_credit_has_stood_lapsed_da218b08` | 1.6 above 12 months; 1.25 above 3 and not above 12; as it stands otherwise. Terms 3 and 12 in figures, both sides of each ✔ |
| `voucher_count_basis` (method) | `counting_vouchers_a_reissue_fee_is_taken_for_7f2cdd01` | two or more → once for each; single + transferable → once, at 1.5 times; otherwise → once. All three, including the untriggered transferable tier ✔ |
| `standing_value_loading` | `value_standing_on_a_lapsed_credit_391b45c6` | 60.00 at or above 2500.00; 25.00 at or above 800.00 and below 2500.00; nothing below 800.00. Bands in figures, both sides ✔ |
| `booking_age_surcharge` | `age_of_the_booking_behind_a_lapsed_credit_89e0bc11` | 45.00 above 36 whole calendar months; 20.00 above 18 and not above 36; nothing otherwise. Terms in figures, four boundary cases worked ✔ |
| `member_fee_relief` (cross-difficulty, club) | `club_points_and_relief_on_the_reissue_fee_c0d9e792` | 0.50 / 0.30 / 0.10 / none, points band 20000 in figures, both limbs of each compound condition, and the boundary worked at 20000 and 19999 ✔ |

**`air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward` — baseline.** `basis_of_the_value_carried_forward_583c198c`
carries the whole `rule` at baseline: "the largest lapsed travel credit standing on the booking, less
the reissue fee charged on the booking, and it is never below zero"; the reissue fee read as "the total
of the credit reissue fee lines posted to the booking's charges"; the `set_lapsed` test; the filing rule
and the traveller position; "It runs for the same validity term as the voucher it replaces, counted from
the day it is reissued"; the user ownership ("The traveller carries the value forward themselves,
because it is their own once-only right of reissue that is spent"); and the rounding. ✔

**`air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward` — six declared factors, every tier:**

|---|---|---|
| `lapsed_set_selection` (method) | `which_lapsed_credits_stand_on_a_booking_c7f57f2c` | two or more lapsed + most recently issued lapsed longer ago than 6 months → total of those issued within the 24-month retention window (with the window's boundary worked at 24 and 25 months); two or more + not longer ago than 6 months → total of every lapsed voucher; otherwise → the largest ✔ |
| `staleness_carry_share` | `how_long_ago_the_booking_was_given_up_74c1dc16` | 0.70 above 12 months; 0.85 above 6 and not above 12; in full otherwise. Both sides of both terms ✔ |
| `lead_traveller_share` | `lead_traveller_share_of_a_party_voucher_418919c0` | non-transferable + three or more base-fare lines → 0.40; non-transferable + exactly two → 0.60; any other case → in full. Both limbs stated as holding together ✔ |
| `card_carry_uplift` (cross-difficulty, club) | `length_of_club_membership_and_carry_uplift_c6e72403` | 0.10 / 0.06 / 0.02 / none, long-membership term 60 months, boundary worked at 60 and 59 ✔ |
| `house_activity_uplift` (cross-difficulty, **stay**) | `hotel_activity_across_the_house_dd02d3e8` | 0.08 at or above 1500.00 with an active card; 0.04 above nothing but below 1500.00 with an active card; 0.02 above nothing with no card; none where nothing is posted. Band in figures, both sides, and the no-card tier spelled out ✔ |
| `service_fee_recovery` | `service_fee_recovery_on_a_carry_forward_9b296899` | 30.00 with two or more service fee lines and the brand fee at or above 25.00; 15.00 with exactly one; nothing otherwise. Band in figures, both sides ✔ |

**Cross-difficulty findability.** `house_activity_uplift` rests on another product's records, and its
document names that product officially and names the record kind it reads: "the room charges posted to
the traveller's **Hotel Rate Plans** stays over the twelve months to the handling date, taken as the
total of those posted **room charge** lines". The blind audit reached it from `find_stay_reservations`
and the `stay_room_charge` rows, i.e. from the words the records use — not from this product's
vocabulary. ✔

**The other four extended policies and their 19 factors** (`air_ext_cancellation_penalty`,
`air_ext_airline_tax_return`, `air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit`, `air_ext_pooled_credit_release`) were
scanned in full for this task too, since the forward scan covers the whole domain: every baseline is
carried complete in its own computation document and every one of their 19 ladders is carried tier by
tier, threshold by threshold, in its own factor document, including tiers no task in this difficulty
triggers (the 0.55 early-notice share, the 1.30 late-notice share, the 45.00 twice-reworked loading,
the halving where a move reaches the brand threshold, the 0.75 long-held tax share, the
airline-cancellation limb of the optional-extras and disrupted-penalty ladders, the 0.35
cancel-for-any-reason offset, the transferable limb of the traveller-pool and name-correction ladders,
and the 0.6 stale-journey release limit). No tier dropped, merged, rounded or softened; no threshold
left under a business name without figures; no method tier compressed into "calculated accordingly".

**One source atom has no prose home.** The `result` assembly order of `air_ext_credit_reissue_fee` and
`air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward` (and of `air_ext_airline_tax_return`) is not carried anywhere:

```
air_ext_credit_reissue_fee:
  (P('credit_reissue_fee_usd') * lapse_loading * fee_multiple + value_loading_usd + age_surcharge_usd)
  * (1 - member_relief) * set_lapsed

air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward:
  (value_standing * carry_share * party_share * (1 + card_uplift + house_uplift)
   - service_recovery_usd - reissue_fee_charged) * set_lapsed
```

Both baselines are exact when no factor is engaged and every ladder is exact; what is unborne is where
each factor lands in the assembly — that the per-voucher multiple binds tighter than the two flat
additions; that the carry share and lead-traveller share bind to the **value standing** alone rather
than to the value carried the baseline sentence defines; that the reissue fee and the service recovery
are subtracted **after** those shares; and that the two uplifts are **summed** rather than compounded.
The last point is sharpened by the sibling policy: `air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit` assembles its
uplift and its offset as `(1 + member_uplift) * (1 - protection_offset_share)`, compounding them, out
of prose indistinguishable from the carry-forward pair. This is the defect the runtime audit records as
R1-1 and R1-2; it is counted here once, as an unhomed source atom.

Every `params` constant of every extended policy appears literally in the corpus (checked
exhaustively). Authoring fields (`baseline`, `evidence`, `cross_difficulty`, `bindings`,
`compute_basis`, `condition`, `resolved_by`, `fallback_reason`) appear nowhere.

`charge_credit_reissue_fee_efe635ea` is `owner="agent"` in `task_tools.py` and "The desk unlocks it and
then calls it, once, to post the charge" in `charging_the_credit_reissue_fee_f52d93be`.

## policy-side notes (Step 4 — reported, not counted in this skill's verdict)

1. **The factor-composition order has no place to live under the current render contract.** A factor
   document may not name the computation document or another factor, and the baseline must be silent
   about any variation; so the order in which factors enter the result cannot, as things stand, be
   written anywhere. That is why the two scored numbers of this task are underivable from the corpus. It
   is reported here as a KB finding because it is what breaks the entailment; where the order ought to
   live is a design question for the render and policy layers, and this report does not prescribe an
   answer.
2. **Same prose, two conventions.** `air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit` compounds its uplift and offset
   while `air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward` sums its two uplifts, from wording that is
   indistinguishable across the four factor documents concerned. Whichever layer settles the convention,
   the two policies presently differ on it.

### source_to_kb (revision_2)

**The unhomed atom now has a home, in both of this task's computations.**

`air_ext_credit_reissue_fee` — the charter now settles the fee in two named stages and the corpus
carries them. `basis_of_the_credit_reissue_fee_cb574e79`:

> "**The two stages in which the fee is settled.** … **The tariff component** is settled first: it is
> the credit reissue fee of the fare brand that produced the voucher, taken at whatever loading the
> time the credit has stood unclaimed earns and then taken as many times as the fee falls due on the
> booking. **The fee charged** is that tariff component with anything added to it in dollars, **added
> once for the booking and never once for each voucher**, and with any relief then taken as a share of
> the whole…"

and each of the six factors now names which stage it enters: `lapse_age_loading` and
`voucher_count_basis` act on **the tariff component**; `standing_value_loading`,
`booking_age_surcharge` and `member_fee_relief` act on **the fee charged**; `lapse_clock_anchor`
decides the count the loading reads.

`air_ext_lapsed_credit_carry_forward` — `basis_of_the_value_carried_forward_583c198c` now opens with
"**What is settled, and in what order**", names **the value standing** as the figure settled first,
puts "anything taken off in dollars, the reissue fee charged on the booking above all, taken off last
of all, after every share and every uplift", and carries the shared convention including the
uplift-combining half. All five factors of this policy now name **the value standing** (or, for the
recovery, "taken off in dollars, last of all") rather than "the value carried", so none can be read as
acting on a figure the fee has already been taken out of.
